body:
Approve for the change, still needs a code yada.

A mentioned before it is a performance problem and threading hazard to directly return objects like that. The server should never have to do any of that.

Users should only ever get object ids and rids from queries and do with those ids manually what they want at their own risk.

I haven't tested every single code path that's touched here, but the change is fairly mechanical and the code looks good to me.

I will likely make a pull request to just have `ObjectDB::get_instance` do an early-out (before its lock) when the `ObjectID` is non-valid. All these `ObjectID::is_valid` checks creates a lot of unfortunate noise, and it seems to be a common enough pattern across the codebase to warrant cleaning up.
